name: Masugaki Kaname
source: The protagonist who started a job as a teacher at a girls' school. Starting from his first day on the job, a series of unfortunate events leads to him being treated as a pervert by all his students. Due to an experience in his youth, he has a strange self-defensive power to "change suffering into pleasure".
